fdroid:com.amnesica.kryptey.name: KryptEY
fdroid:com.amnesica.kryptey.summary: Keyboard for secure E2EE communication through signal protocol in any messenger
fdroid:com.amnesica.kryptey.description:
Communicate securely and independent, regardless of the legal situation or whether messengers use E2EE. No server needed. #ChatKontrolleStoppen
 Why KryptEY? 
Breaking of end-to-end encryption (E2EE) by laws such as the planned EU chat control is an ongoing issue. Content in messengers that use E2EE, such as Whatsapp or Signal, could thus be monitored by third parties. E2EE is often, but not always, standard in messengers. There are proven methods for E2EE such as PGP. However, these methods are sometimes cumbersomely integrated and require a lot of effort to use.
KryptEY is an Android keyboard that implements the Signal protocol. The keyboard works messenger-independently and both the X3DH Key Agreement Protocol and the Double Ratchet Algorithm work without a server, thus it enables a highly independent use of the protocol.
 Features 
Based upon Simple Keyboard ( https://github.com/rkkr/simple-keyboard ), KryptEY adds a view above the Keyboard for the E2EE functionality.
* use E2EE through Signal Protocol in any messenger
* encryption/decryption of messages
* enter message through separate text field in keyboard
* use clipboard to read messages
* manage contacts in own contact list in keyboard
* message log to view sent/received messages
* send messages as plain JSON (raw mode) or hidden in a decoy text (fairytale mode)
* verification of E2EE functionality via fingerprint
* Q&A View for questions
* dark & light theme
See https://github.com/amnesica/KryptEY/blob/master/KRYPTEY.md for further information on how KryptEY is working.
 Security 
The existing security properties for the Signal Protocol are also valid for the keyboard.
 Limitations 
The keyboard was designed as a POC and only allows 1-to-1 conversations. However, the application can also be used in a group chat to a limited extent. Here, a message can be directed to a specific chat partner and not to all people. Other participants of the group chat cannot decrypt the message.
Text messages in Telegram are getting copied as HTML and not as plain text. When decoding the message with the fairytale mode the copied message is compromised and can't be read properly. Therefore, it can't be decoded at all. However, the raw mode works properly. When using KryptEY with Telegram we recommend the raw mode.
Some messengers like Threema only allows up to 3500 bytes per message. Therefore, different character input limitations apply. To stay under the 3500 bytes limit, only 500 characters are allowed for raw and fairytale mode. For convenience these limitation applies for all messengers.
 Demo 
For a demonstration on how KryptEY is used see https://github.com/amnesica/KryptEY/tree/master#demo 
KryptEY was created by mellitopia and amnesica. The code is open source and can be found at https://github.com/amnesica/KryptEY

fdroid:io.github.antonkulaga.glucowatch.name: GlucoWatch
fdroid:io.github.antonkulaga.glucowatch.summary: Dexcom or Nightscout glucose, chart and forecast on a Wear OS watch
fdroid:io.github.antonkulaga.glucowatch.description:
Shows your glucose on a Wear OS watch: the current value with a trend arrow, a chart across the whole round screen, and an optional forecast. It comes as a watch face, three tiles (glucose only; clock, glucose, heart rate and battery; and a light version), and an app, in GlucoseDAO colours. The face and both glucose-and-clock tiles also show your heart rate from the watch's own sensor.
The watch reads Dexcom Share or your own Nightscout directly. The optional GlucoPhone companion can relay readings over Bluetooth or copy the login to the watch. Download the phone APK from https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/glucowatch/releases and install it on the phone. The watch still works without it or any extra server. Dexcom readings need Share turned on in the official Dexcom app, with at least one follower.
For a Medtronic MiniMed pump, the watch can show CareLink glucose and insulin data. Sign in through the GlucoPhone companion, then choose "Get CareLink sign-in from phone" in watch Settings. CareLink is optional; Nightscout and demo data work without it. Phone ONNX forecasts can also be shown on the watch by choosing "Phone app model".
With Nightscout the watch also shows insulin and carbs on board from your loop (AAPS, Trio, iAPS, Loop), boluses and carbs on the chart, the last bolus and carbs, and the loop's own forecast. Nightscout works through API v1 or v3, with an access token or none for a public site.
This is not a medical device. Do not make treatment decisions from it. Keep using your CGM's official app and alarms.
Dexcom Share and CareLink are proprietary services read through undocumented interfaces, so a change on their side can stop that source until an update. Dexcom, Medtronic, MiniMed and CareLink are trademarks of their owners. GlucoWatch is not affiliated with them.
Install GlucoWatch on the watch. To use its watch face, install the separate GlucoWatch face package on the watch too. The app and tiles work without that face. The watch has no F-Droid app, and installing F-Droid on a phone does not copy these packages to the watch.
Download the watch app from its F-Droid page when available, or from https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/glucowatch/releases. Download the separate watch-face APK from its own F-Droid page when available, or from the same GitHub release. Each package is reviewed and published separately. On the watch, open Settings, About watch, Software information, and tap Software version 5 times. In Developer options, turn on ADB debugging and Wireless debugging. The watch and the computer have to be on the same Wi-Fi.
Open Wireless debugging, tap Pair new device, and note the IP address, the pairing port, and the 6-digit code. The main Wireless debugging screen shows a second port. That one is the connection port.
On a computer with Android platform-tools installed:
adb pair : 
adb connect : 
adb install -r 
adb install -r 
Open GlucoWatch, tap Settings, and choose Dexcom Share (username, password and region) or Nightscout (the site's address and, for a private site, an access token with the readable role). Tap Save & test. Long-press the current watch face, swipe to the end, tap Add watch face and choose GlucoWatch face. If a slot is empty, long-press the face, tap Customize, tap the slot, and choose Glucose or Glucose chart. For a tile, swipe left from the face to the end of the tiles, tap Add tiles and choose Glucose, Glucose, time and heart, or Glucose (light). apple-macos:932618148.name: Unity Client
apple-macos:932618148.description:
Unity Client is a next generation network-based full-duplex intercom system that is incredibly simple to use, yet is as powerful as traditional systems costing many times more! Unity Client works in conjunction with the Unity Intercom Server, available from www.unityintercom.com.
The Unity Intercom system can be used for a variety of applications
 • Multi-camera live video production (including Tally!)
 • Fleet/delivery management
 • Hotel staff
 • Hospitality personnel 
 • Construction/installation crews
 • And many, many more
Works over any IP based network
 • Unity Client works using either Wi-Fi or direct ethernet connections. Users can be within the same network as the Unity server, or located around the world communicating over the internet.
External program feed
 • Unity server comes with a built-in, sample program feed, but can be upgraded for a custom program feed.
Supports up to 6 channels and 58 users
 • Users can be restricted to access any or all of the 6 channels for talk/listen, listen only, or no access.
 • Additional users can be purchased, up to a total of 58 simultaneous users on the Unity system.
Private user-to-user communications
 • You can communicate with any active Unity user directly in a private communication session. No other users can hear the conversation.
Push notifications
 • Push-notify offline users to tell them to join a Unity conversation. Acknowledging the notification starts Unity automatically.
Integrates with external audio I/O
 • Upgrade Unity Server to allow audio to be routed to and from an external Com system, effectively creating wireless com stations that work with a traditional hard-wired intercom over any existing network.
External tally support
 • The Unity server can be upgraded to accept tally information from a variety of video switching systems, and can send this information to remote Unity app users. Both the Unity Mac Client and Unity iOS devices become actual tally lights, showing both preview and on-air talent tally functionality.
 • Great for production environments!

• Two hours of radar history; drag the time slider or let it play

ALERTS
• National Weather Service warnings, watches and advisories drawn on the map: tornado, severe thunderstorm, flood, winter and marine
• Click any area for the full alert text
• Hurricanes and tropical storms: NHC forecast cone, track and forecast points, refreshed every 10 minutes
FORECAST
• Current conditions, hourly forecast and 10-day forecast for any place in the world

flathub:io.github.smcameron.space-nerds-.name: Space Nerds in Space
flathub:io.github.smcameron.space-nerds-.description:
Space Nerds In Space is an open source (GPLv2) cooperative multiplayer starship simulator for linux. So go out and get together with a crew of your linux-nerd friends and their computers in a room with a projector or TV, and go forth and explore the galaxy.
 Space Nerds In Space allows you to man the various bridge controls of a starship. You can play Space Nerds In Space alone or with friends, but you really need a crew of 2 or more players to master a starship.
 Various stations are Captain (Main Screen), Helms, Weapons, Communications, Science/Scanning, and Engineering/Repair.
 Note that unlike many other fine bridge simulators, Space Nerds In Space is fully 3D.
 Space Nerds In Space also has an option where someone can take the role of dungeon master and modify the game universe in progress.
 There are warp gates, nebula that block sensors and allow you to hide, mining, courier missions, and of course many hostiles. Creating your own scriptable missions in lua is possible and encouraged. And much, much more.

 Stop wasting time searching through your email or printing out your digital passes. Download Passes now and keep all your passes in one convenient location.

INSTALLATION
You need 2 components:
This browser extension
The NuGet package: BlazorDeveloperTools
dotnet add package BlazorDeveloperTools
USAGE
Run your Blazor app
Open DevTools (F12)
Navigate to the "Blazor" tab
Explore Components or record a Timeline profile
TIMELINE PROFILER
Click Record, interact with your app, click Stop
Switch between Events, Ranked, and Flamegraph views
Click any event to see why it rendered

firefox-addons:630686.name: Undo Close Tab Button
firefox-addons:630686.description:
Adds toolbar buttons for quick access to undo the closing of tabs. 
The button has two modes depending on what setting is selected. It either simply reopens the most recently closed tab. Or it can show a list of recently closed tabs so you can pick which one to open again. The number of tabs in this list is configurable.
None of this is really new functionality. You can undo closing a tab with Ctrl + Shift + T or from the tab context menu. And the menu is already exists under History > Recently Closed Tabs. This extension just makes it faster to get at.
For those asking for the old multi-function button back: Make sure you set this button so it does not show the drop down (the default setting, so change it back if you modified it). Then install Close Tab History Button and put it next this one. That is the closest I can get you to the old behavior for now. I am working on a patch for Firefox so that the possibility of doing this will come back.
Consider installing this button's greatest rival the Close Tab Button .
I am looking for translations for this extension if you are interested in helping check out the project on crowdin .
This is part of a set of tab related buttons: Reload All Tabs Button , Stop All Button , Tabs List Button , Close All Tabs Button , Copy Tab Button , Reload Skip Cache Button , Undo Close Tab Button , Close tabs to the right Button and Close Other Tabs Button .
The extension is part of the Toolbar Buttons project and is built with the MozButton SDK . Follow us on Twitter , or get involved on GitHub .
If you have ideas for new features we are more then happy to consider them for the next release. Just leave a comment, or better post to our Forums

apple-macos:1035361157.description:
OpenMaps turns your iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac into a complete outdoor and marine navigation kit, powered by free, community-sourced OpenStreetMap data.
OUTDOOR & MARINE IN ONE APP
Switch between an Outdoor profile (hiking, trekking, mountain biking, trail running) and a Marine profile with OpenSeaMap nautical overlays, buoys, lighthouses, depths and harbours. One app for the trail and the water.
WORKS WHERE THERE'S NO SIGNAL
Topographic tiles are cached on device and can be pre-downloaded, so your map keeps working deep in the mountains or offshore where there's no connection.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED OUTDOORS
• 6 open-source topographic & nautical map styles
• Draw routes tap-by-tap with live distance & elevation
• Turn-by-turn directions with haptic guidance
• Import and export Garmin FIT files, plus GPX
• Find nearby POIs: refuges, water, peaks, marinas, fuel and more
• Built-in tools: compass, altimeter, sunrise/sunset, coordinates
• Live weather, wind and conditions for your location
ON YOUR WRIST & ON YOUR DESK
• Apple Watch app: record workouts with HealthKit, standalone map, Digital Crown zoom, Always-On mode and on-wrist route navigation
• Watch complications & widgets: altimeter, nearest POI, live workout, weather
• Mac app: menu bar access, Spotlight search and Quick Look map previews
OPENMAPS PRO
Remove all ads and support development. One purchase covers iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac: monthly, yearly or once for life.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID on confirmation. Manage or cancel anytime in iOS Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.andreapiani.com/openmaps/privacy/
